patch_description:
Replace the random cloud with a symmetric 14-point construction consisting of the 8 vertices of a cube and 6 axis vertices.  The axis radius is chosen so that the largest axis-to-axis distance equals the largest axis-to-opposite-cube distance:
\(2a = \sqrt{(a+1)^2+2}\), giving \(a=(1+\sqrt{10})/3\).

This balances the diameter constraints while retaining a comparatively large minimum distance.  The construction is deterministic, requires no optimization at evaluation time, has exactly 14 finite 3D points, and is substantially better conditioned than independent Gaussian samples.
